title: Recoverable preview worker
responsibility: Starts and supervises the owned Node preview worker, checks readiness and health, restarts it at the same URL with backoff, and stops it on close.

inputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.constructor.entry
inputs.description: Compiled Node entry path for the worker process.

inputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.constructor.args
inputs.description: Validated worker arguments passed unchanged to each replacement.

inputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.constructor.url
inputs.description: Stable worker URL used for readiness and health checks and returned to callers.

outputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.start
outputs.description: Starts a worker, waits for its health response to match the child PID and token, then schedules recovery checks and returns its URL/close handle.

outputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.close
outputs.description: Stops health checks and gracefully stops the owned child, escalating to SIGKILL after two seconds; does not respawn.

errors.name: Preview worker startup failure
errors.description: start rejects when the child cannot be launched, exits before readiness, remains unhealthy through the startup deadline, or the service was stopped. Recovery retries later with backoff.
examples: Preview worker did not become ready.
